TLT ETF analysis: US Treasury yields and inflows jump
results.description: The iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) continues its strong freefall, reaching its lowest level since September 2023 as cracks in the bond market accelerated. TLT plunged to $77, down 11% this year and 46% in the last five years. Despite all this, investors have continued to buy the dip. TLT ETF inflows rise despite weakness in the bond market The iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF has been in a freefall this year and is now at the lowest level in years. Despite all this, investors have continued to allocate capital to the fund. ETF Db data shows that the fund had over $2 billion in inflows in the last month, bringing the six-month figure to $8.6 billion.…
